extraction.document_summary: AIA Ultimate Critical Cover (UCC) is a Singapore life insurance critical illness plan that provides multi-stage critical illness protection across early, intermediate and major stages, with a “Ultimate Reset Benefit” that resets coverage to 100% of the coverage amount every 12 months after the last critical illness claim. The brochure states “unlimited claims” applies to major-stage critical illnesses, with only one claim payable per stage and the total across all stages of the same critical illness capped at 100% of the coverage amount. For early and intermediate stages, it describes a maximum claim limit of 500% of coverage amount across early/intermediate stage claims, and eligibility is “covered for 150 medical conditions” across stages. The policy terminates after the death or accidental death benefit is paid. Riders mentioned include an enhancer (Ultimate Relapse Benefit and Catastrophic Critical Illness Benefit) and optional premium waiver/payor benefit riders that waive future premiums upon specified diagnoses or death/disability.
quality_notes: Brochure contains clear core mechanics (unlimited claims for major stage, Ultimate Reset Benefit, relapse and catastrophic benefits via an enhancer, and death/accidental death payouts).
Exact entry age limits, premium terms/frequencies, underwriting basis, and detailed exclusions are not specified in a structured way; exclusions are described only generically.

The list of covered critical illnesses is provided by table, but individual benefit amounts for each condition are not itemized beyond specific notes (e.g., Angioplasty cap and relapse waiting period).

policies.quick_summary: Critical illness plan with coverage reset every 12 months and “unlimited claims” for major-stage critical illnesses; offers death (5%) and accidental death (100%) benefits. Coverage term can be selected up to age 65, 75, or 85. Ultimate Relapse and Catastrophic Critical Illness features are described as an enhancer/add-on for UCC customers (not part of base benefits). Only one claim per stage and stage/coverage caps apply; policy terminates after death or accidental death payout is made, and a relapse rider has a 2-year waiting period described in the brochure terms section (rider linkage). Pre-existing conditions are mentioned as excluded with no benefit payable.

important_caveats: Unlimited claims apply to major stage of critical illnesses; only one claim payable for each stage and total across all stages for the same critical illness shall not exceed 100% of the coverage amount.
Early and intermediate stage critical illnesses have a maximum claim limit of 500% of coverage amount.
Ultimate Reset Benefit resets to 100% only if the UCC policy is in force 12 months after the last critical illness claim.
Pre-existing conditions are mentioned as excluded with no benefits payable; waiting/survival periods are applicable (details not provided in structured form).
